claims.label: NY Post article identifies 301 East 66th Street as building Epstein used to house underage victims
claims.claim: The displayed New York Post article identifies 301 East 66th Street, a 16-story post-war condo between First and Second Avenues, as a building where Jeffrey Epstein kept underage victims and which functioned as a logistical hub for his operations.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full NY Post article and underlying unsealed records to verify the address, building ownership chain, and named victims.

claims.label: Epstein's address book labeled certain apartments as "apartments for models"
claims.claim: Per the displayed NY Post article, some apartments in the 301 East 66th Street building were labeled in Jeffrey Epstein's address book as "apartments for models."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the cited civil complaint or sworn testimony referencing the address-book labeling and compare to Next Model Management operational addresses.

claims.label: NY Post article photo of the building was courtesy of Corcoran real estate
claims.claim: The photo embedded in the displayed NY Post article depicting the building was credited to Corcoran real estate.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Corcoran's listing history for 301 East 66th Street and identify the Corcoran president referenced in Epstein files as a Rothschild.

claims.label: Alexander brothers convicted on all 10 counts including sex trafficking of a minor
claims.claim: Per the displayed news clip, a federal jury in Manhattan found Tal, Oren, and Alon Alexander guilty of all 10 counts, including sex trafficking; Tal and Alon also convicted of sex trafficking a minor; Oren and Alon also convicted of sexual abuse. Sentencing scheduled for August.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain federal court docket for the Southern District of New York case, cross-reference Epstein-file redaction entries, and document Kushner/White House visit records for the brothers.

claims.label: Sarah Huckabee Sanders signed proclamation supporting Club America in Arkansas high schools alongside Erika Kirk
claims.claim: The host says Arkansas Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders signed a proclamation with Erika Kirk at her side announcing support for every high school in Arkansas to adopt Club America (TPUSA high-school chapter program); in the clip she plays, Sanders welcomes Erika Kirk and says Club America is launching in Arkansas.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the official proclamation text and any associated Arkansas Department of Education guidance; verify whether the proclamation is symbolic or carries operational force.

claims.label: 2017 article records Erika Kirk stating she partnered with Renee Crossman of United Hands Romania
claims.claim: Per the displayed 2017 article, Erika Kirk stated: "I am happy to collaborate with United Hands Romania Association and Renee Crossman, the president of this organization, but also with the representatives of the Antonio Placement Center."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original 2017 article source and verify the Antonio Placement Center in Constanta; cross-check Romanian nonprofit registration records for United Hands Romania.

claims.label: Erika Says Base Staff Did Not Trust United Hands Head
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Erika Kirk says the people at the base in Constanța do not trust the woman who heads United Hands Romania Association in Ohio because they have no connection to her; the host characterizes this as the Romanian orphans not trusting her.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the interview source and date; obtain statements from orphanage staff or volunteers regarding Crossman's access to children.

claims.label: Children of God founder David Berg advocated sexual relations with minors
claims.claim: Per the displayed Romanian investigative article, Children of God founder David Berg claimed incest and sex involving minors were permitted; the article states Berg made his daughter Faithy a sexual partner when she reached age 12.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with established historical documentation of the Children of God / The Family movement's teachings on minor sexual activity.

claims.label: Christina Babin stated adult cult members showed her how to have sex as a child
claims.claim: Per the displayed Megyn Kelly interview clip, Christina Babin described being taken by an adult couple in the night as a child and shown how to have sex, attributing the instruction to a letter sent by cult leader David Berg.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the 2018 Megyn Kelly episode and Babin's full interview; corroborate with other documented survivor testimony regarding Berg's "sexual sharing" directive.

claims.label: Hospital transport van photos show scattered material across back seat
claims.claim: Per the displayed van interior photo, the host says it looks very much to her like shattered glass across the back seat, and notes some people think it could be part of Charlie Kirk's microphone.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain high-resolution originals; have forensic imaging analysts characterize the scattered material and compare to TPUSA's account of vehicle interior condition.

claims.label: 9/10 video shows Charlie's necklace with magnet clasp still attached after impact
claims.claim: The host says the displayed video shows Charlie Kirk's necklace whipping upward first after impact, and that the magnet clasp is still on him.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare video frame-by-frame to the multiple conflicting necklace-recovery stories told by Erika Kirk, Frank, and Brian Harpole (as referenced by host).

claims.label: 9/10 video shows no blood traveling backward from Charlie's position
claims.claim: Per the displayed video, the host says no blood is seen heading backward from Charlie Kirk after he is hit, which she says instantly felt wrong for the .30-06 account.
claims.investigative_direction: Engage forensic video analysts to assess the blood pattern in the displayed footage against expected wound ballistics for a .30-06 round.

claims.label: 9/10 video shows Charlie's hands did not grab anything from the table as he fell
claims.claim: Per the displayed video, when Charlie Kirk's hands first make contact with the table, he does not grasp or take any object from it.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare video evidence to prior commentary alleging he grabbed an item from the table; verify resolution of that sub-theory.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk video clip names Thomas Massie as one of his favorite congressmen
claims.claim: Per the displayed video clip, Charlie Kirk names Rep. Thomas Massie as one of his favorite members of Congress and welcomes him to discuss the new Church Committee.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify date and program of the clip; corroborate via multiple Charlie Kirk video instances praising Massie (per host, spanning 2016 through 2023).

claims.label: Turning Point Action tweeted labeling Massie as needing to be replaced
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point Action tweeted that Thomas Massie was a "rhino" who needed to be replaced, and shows the tweet.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve original tweet (including any subsequent edits/deletions); identify the author of the TP Action account; document timing relative to Massie Committee work.

claims.label: X community note fact-checked Turning Point Action's Massie tweet
claims.claim: Per the displayed X community note, the Massie tweet from Turning Point Action was fact-checked with the statement: "Rep. Thomas Massie was one of Charlie Kirk's favorite congressman."
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve community note metadata; identify raters and any subsequent updates to the note.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk praised Massie as favorite congressman in multiple clips across years
claims.claim: The host says Massie's reply shows a tweet of Charlie Kirk calling Massie one of his favorite congressmen, and that Massie had been Charlie's favorite congressman from at least 2016 through 2023.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile and date-stamp all public Charlie Kirk video appearances praising Massie; document the platform and audience of each.

claims.label: Romanian investigative article identifies Renee Crossman as having come from the Children of God / The Family religious sect
claims.claim: Per the displayed Romanian investigative article, Renee Crossman is identified by the Romanian investigative team as originating from the Children of God religious sect (now called The Family).
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full investigative article; verify Crossman's documented affiliation independently; examine United Hands Romania registration and operational history.

claims.label: 2017 article identifies Antonio Placement Center in Constanta as Erika Kirk's partnership site
claims.claim: Per the displayed 2017 article, Erika Kirk's partnership for the benefit of Romanian children was conducted with both the Antonio Placement Center in Constanta and Renee Crossman's United Hands Romania Association.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Antonio Placement Center in Constanta exists as documented; obtain Romanian-language records and Constantine base access logs referenced by Kirk.

claims.label: 9/10 video shows Dan pushing Charlie to the ground
claims.claim: Per the displayed video, an individual the host identifies as "Dan" is observed pushing Charlie Kirk to the ground after he is hit.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the individual referred to as "Dan" via displayed video and corroborate identity with official event staff rosters.

claims.label: Host Says Harpole SUV Story Did Not Match Circumstances
claims.claim: The host says Baron Coleman is working on examining why "they" told the story that Brian Harpole was hanging out of the SUV, which she says was not the circumstance when they pulled out.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain official TPUSA narrative statements regarding Harpole's posture and timing; compare to multiple displayed photo angles.

claims.label: Thomas Massie publicly questioned what had "gotten into" Turning Point USA
claims.claim: Per the displayed Massie reply tweet, Massie directly asked Turning Point USA what had "gotten into y'all" in response to their tweet targeting him.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve full reply-tweet thread; identify any subsequent TPUSA responses and document the public dispute timeline.

claims.label: Romanian investigative article states Children of God cult was instructed to disperse into nonprofit work
claims.claim: The host says Renee Crossman defends the cult, which, according to the investigative piece, was subsequently instructed to disperse and hide themselves in the world of nonprofit.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with documented post-1970s directives from David Berg and successor leadership regarding dispersal strategy; examine nonprofit registration patterns of former members.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Said He Would Die to Awaken Humanity
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk said he was going to die to help awaken humanity.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the recorded or written statement in which Charlie Kirk said he would die to awaken humanity and its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: He said that he was going to die to help awaken humanity. Let's see. Welcome back to Candace.

claims.label: Host Says Source Says Erika Was Next Model Management Point Person for Housing Models
claims.claim: The host says she was told that Erika was the point person for Next Model Management when it came to housing young models, dealing with apartments in a white building the sources placed near 68th Street between Second and Third Avenue.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the sources and obtain their statements; match the white building to property-management records for Next Model Management apartments.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika Frantzve was, as we were told, the point person to the firm when it came to housing young models.

claims.label: Host Says Viewers Sent a Building Owned by Mark Epstein Matching the White Building
claims.claim: The host says viewers sent her a building that could match the white building description and that it was owned by Mark Epstein, Jeffrey Epstein's brother, who inherited all of his wealth.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull New York City property records (ACRIS) for the building viewers identified and its ownership chain; confirm the street address and whether it is 301 East 66th Street.
claims.transcript_snippet: A building that was owned by Mark Epstein, Jeffrey Epstein's brother who inherited all of his wealth.

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the cited civil complaints and sworn testimony and check which guests and dignitaries are actually named.
claims.transcript_snippet: the underage girls that he trafficked more than a dozen also cycled between wealthy guests, notable foreign dignitaries, and Epstein staffers.

claims.claim: The host reads from the article that one victim said in a 2022 account that the apartment was small, stocked with Danone yogurt, fruit and cookies, before she was taken about nine blocks to Epstein's townhouse at 9 East 71st Street for a massage.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the 2022 account quoted in the article and confirm the building and the distances described.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was relatively small and there was Danone yogurt in the fridge and a basket of fruit and cookies on the counter.

claims.claim: The host reads from the article that civil filings allege the condos were used to house young women brought from overseas and provided with living quarters, transportation and other benefits to secure compliance.

claims.transcript_snippet: And civil filings allege the condos were used to house young women brought from overseas and provided with living quarters, uh transportation, and other benefits to secure compliance.

claims.claim: The host says that according to Jeffrey Epstein's files the Corcoran president was a Rothschild.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Epstein document cited and compare with Corcoran Group's published leadership records.
claims.transcript_snippet: remember the Corcoran president, according to Jeffrey Epstein's files, was a Rothschild.

claims.claim: The host says Tal, Oren and Alon Alexander are Jared Kushner's Israeli business friends who sold Ivanka and Jared their Miami mansion.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Miami-Dade property records for the Kushner purchase and any Alexander brothers role as broker or seller.
claims.transcript_snippet: Jared Kushner's Israeli business friends who sold Ivanka and Jared their Miami mansion and they were just found guilty of sex trafficking.

claims.label: Host Says Patel Said No Trafficking Evidence in the Files Yet the Alexanders Were in Them
claims.claim: The host says Kash Patel said there was no evidence of trafficking in the Epstein files, yet the Alexander brothers were in the files.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Patel's statement on trafficking evidence and check the released files for any Alexander entries.
claims.transcript_snippet: Remember, Kash Patel said there was no evidence of trafficking in the files, none. Yet, these Israeli-American brothers, Tal, Oren, and Alon Alexander, were indeed in the files.

claims.claim: The host says the Alexander brothers visited the White House multiple times and were invited to the annual Hanukkah party.
claims.investigative_direction: Request White House visitor logs and Hanukkah reception guest lists covering the Alexander brothers.
claims.transcript_snippet: They certainly visited the White House multiple times. They even were invited to the annual uh Hanukkah party.

claims.claim: The host says the Alexander brothers' last names were redacted from the Epstein files, and notes the public was told redactions were limited to protecting against child pornography.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the redacted and unredacted Epstein file releases for Alexander entries and the stated redaction rationale.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm wondering if it's because of that that they had their last names redacted from the Epstein files. We were told that the redactions were limited to protecting us from child pornography.

claims.claim: The host says Congressman Thomas Massie played a leading role in exposing the Epstein redactions and that Trump now wants him primaried in Kentucky because, she says, Israel wants him out.

claims.label: Host Says the Alexander Brothers Were Revealed Because of Massie
claims.claim: The host says the Alexander brothers were revealed because of Massie, and had just been found guilty in a major sex trafficking case.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace how the Alexander names entered the public record after the Epstein file release and Massie's role in it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Uh the brothers were revealed because of him and they were, like I told you, just found guilty in a major sex trafficking case.

claims.claim: The news clip says all three Alexander brothers were arrested in December 2024 and that the jury heard from 11 women who accused them of rape or sexual assault.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Southern District of New York docket and trial coverage for arrest dates and witness count.
